quarterly_data.quarter: Renesas press release: Renesas Unveils Industry's First 650V GaN in Dual-Side (09-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Renesas launched the TP65H020G4PLSGBD, a 650V D-Mode GaN device on its Gen IV Plus GaN architecture with dual-side cooling (company claim: industry's first) for 800V HVDC AI data center power conversion: 20 mOhm on-resistance in an 8 x 8mm dual-side-cooled PQFN package (57% smaller footprint than the 10 x 15mm TOLT package; top-side thermal impedance lowered by 10%), supporting up to 700V operation. It targets the 800V DC/DC intermediate bus converter stage stepping down to 48V, 12V or 6V, and the battery backup and capacitor bank stages of the sidecar power rack. The package was defined in collaboration with major AI infrastructure customers (not named); Renesas is sampling the device to major AI datacenter OEMs and ODMs, with mass production planned for mid-2027. A 6kW 800V-to-48V LLC DCX reference design on the device with a Renesas RA6T3 MCU reaches 2.6 kW/in3 power density. Paired with Renesas controllers, gate drivers and MCUs it is offered as a one-stop 800V power solution for OEMs, ODMs and hyperscalers.
quarterly_data.figure: 650V GaN, 20 mOhm, 8 x 8mm DSC package; sampling now, mass production planned mid-2027
